newsitem.title: USA: OMB'S Raines optimistic on budget talks.
newsitem.headline: OMB'S Raines optimistic on budget talks.

text.p: Office of Management and Budget Director Frank Raines said Tuesday planned White House meetings with congressional budget leaders could be the start of negotiations leading to a balanced budget.
Speaking to the Electronic Industries Association, Raines said Wednesday's talks could "kick off a serious round of discussions to lead to a balanced budget."

He said President Bill Clinton decided to seek the talks with House and Senate committee budget leaders following favorable comments by House Speaker Newt Gingrich (R-Ga.) and Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott (R-Miss.) which showed "flexibility" on budget and tax issues.
